messages:
Priya Rao: pager just fired for p99 latency on chat/completions (route=/v1/chat/completions). p99 ~1.5s, baseline is 350ms. Affects models: mistral-7b, mistral-instruct. Started at 10:02 UTC, right after the 10:00 deploy. @jonathan can you pick this up? :rotating_light:

inc-bot: Incident created: INC-2023-11-01-143. Pager routed to eng-oncall. See /incidents/INC-2023-11-01-143

sre-bot: Alert detail: alert=latency.p99.chat_completions, threshold=1200ms, routes=[/v1/chat/completions]. Recent spikes correlated with increased tail latency on GPU pod pool gw-prod-2. Attachments: logs summary.

Jonathan Li: on it. I see increased queuing on a subset of inference workers (gw-prod-2a/b). CPU on control plane ok, but worker GPU utilization and NVME I/O spikes. Pulling logs and heap stats.

Maeve O'Connor: I can help run mitigations. Two options: 1) temporary route-level squelch to stop paging noise while we triage, 2) switch a fraction of traffic to a lower-latency fallback model (redwood-mini or quantized variant). Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Priya Rao: Let's do both in sequence. Squash paging first so we don't wake more people. Then try fallback routing for 20% of traffic to see if latency drop holds. Also note potential customer impact—this route is used by a few large customers.

Jonathan Li: agreed. Squish paging by increasing noise_gate for this alert from p99>1200ms -> p99>2000ms and require 3m sustained. I'll push a temporary alert override.

Jonathan Li: Applying override now (runbook snippet):

```
# temporary alert override
alerts:
  - name: latency.p99.chat_completions
    scope: route:/v1/chat/completions
    override_until: 2023-11-01T11:30:00Z
    conditions:
      p99: 2000
      sustained_for: 180
```

Jonathan Li: override applied. Pager noise suppressed. :white_check_mark:

Maeve O'Connor: Next I'll add a traffic-split to route 20% -> mistral-quantized (compatible variant) using the router tool. Command: `rw-router set-split --route /v1/chat/completions --splits mistral-quantized:20,mistral:80`. Running now.

Maeve O'Connor: Split applied. Watching metrics.

sre-bot: Router change detected by infra: route=/v1/chat/completions, new_splits=[{"mistral-quantized":20,"mistral":80}], change_id=chg-9876

Jonathan Li: Early signal: p95 unchanged, p99 trending down from 1.5s -> 820ms on the split traffic. Overall p99 for route down to ~900ms. Looks promising.

Priya Rao: Good. Can we keep the split for 30m while we stabilize? Also create a temporary dashboard tile for per-model p99 so we can see if specific models are the culprit.

Maeve O'Connor: Creating a quick dashboard now (saved query name: latency-per-model-chat). Adding p95/p99 timeseries with model tag.

Jonathan Li: Found root-ish cause: a small subset of GPU nodes in gw-prod-2 had a bad firmware patch applied (IO scheduler regressions) in the 10:00 deploy bundle. Those nodes show elevated NVME IO wait and kernel logs with 'nvme: timeout' bursts. We're cordoning them and shifting work.

Maeve O'Connor: Cordoned nodes and draining. New workers spun up to replace them and router is balancing away. Expect steady state in ~8-12 mins.

sre-bot: Node drain complete on nodes [gw-prod-2a-07, gw-prod-2b-03]. New pods scheduled.

Jonathan Li: p99 has stabilized at ~360ms after traffic split + node cordon. Rolling back the 20% split now to let normal model palette resume, but leave a canary 5% on mistral-quantized for safety.

Maeve O'Connor: Split updated: mistral-quantized:5,mistral:95.

Priya Rao: Great triage. Next steps: 1) raise alert gating permanently to be per-route+per-model (we got too many false positives by only route-level), 2) add a noise gating policy that requires sustained 3m window and at least 2 distinct worker pools affected, 3) create a per-route per-model p99 dashboard and automated regression alerts to PR authors when new deploys increase p99 by >30%.

Jonathan Li: I'll open the alerting PR with example config. Proposed alert rules (YAML snippet):

```
# proposed permanent rule
alerts:
  - name: latency.p99.chat_completions.per_route_model
    scope: route:/v1/chat/completions
    dimensions: [model]
    conditions:
      p99: 800ms
      sustained_for: 180
    noise_gate:
      min_affected_pools: 2
      min_requests: 100
```

Jonathan Li: Also adding a runbook step to try temporary traffic-split to a fallback model before paging.

Priya Rao: Good. Maeve please own dashboards and attach a link in PR. Jonathan, please include timestamps and evidence in the PR (node IDs, kernel logs, before/after charts). I'll own postmortem and customer impact comms — will draft an incident summary for customers who may have seen elevated latencies.

Maeve O'Connor: Created dashboard and attached to PR: dashboard/id/latency-per-model-chat-20231101. Also added an alert panel that breaks down p99 by model and pool.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2023-11-01-143 marked as RESOLVED at 10:31 UTC. Root cause: firmware/IO regression on subset of gw-prod-2 nodes applied with 10:00 deploy. Mitigation: node cordon + fallback model routing.

Priya Rao: Couple of follow-ups: - schedule a temporary alerting audit to roll out per-model thresholds across critical routes (eng-platform + eng-sre), - add a deploy checklist item to prevent anomalous firmware in node images, - run a 72h regression monitor on p99 after we roll the fixed image.

Jonathan Li: I'll open the PRs: alerting change + runbook tweak + deploy checklist entry. ETA EOD today for alerting PR.

Maeve O'Connor: I'll do the dashboard follow-ups and add an automated chart to buildkite smoke so pre-deploy smoke can catch NVME regressions.

Priya Rao: Thanks everyone. Filing postmortem stub under /postmortems/INC-2023-11-01-143. We can populate with timelines and customers impacted. :memo:
